name: Huntington Beach
intro: CAIR SPA is right here in Huntington Beach, on Brookhurst Street in the southeast part of the city, a short drive from the beach and Pacific Coast Highway.

name: Fountain Valley
route: a straight drive down Brookhurst Street
intro: Fountain Valley is our closest neighbor. CAIR SPA is a few minutes south of the city on Brookhurst Street, the same road that runs through Fountain Valley.

name: Costa Mesa
route: Adams Avenue across the Santa Ana River, then Brookhurst Street
intro: From Costa Mesa, CAIR SPA is a quick trip west on Adams Avenue, just across the Santa Ana River in Huntington Beach.

name: Newport Beach
route: Pacific Coast Highway (CA-1) north, then Brookhurst Street
intro: From Newport Beach, CAIR SPA is an easy drive up Pacific Coast Highway to Brookhurst Street in Huntington Beach.

name: Westminster
route: Brookhurst Street south, or I-405 to the Brookhurst Street exit
intro: From Westminster, CAIR SPA is a straight run south on Brookhurst Street or a short hop on I-405.

name: Garden Grove
route: Euclid Street or Brookhurst Street south
intro: From Garden Grove, CAIR SPA is a straight drive south on Brookhurst or Euclid Street to Huntington Beach.

name: Irvine
intro: From Irvine, CAIR SPA is a short drive up I-405 to the Brookhurst Street exit in Huntington Beach.

name: Santa Ana
route: Bristol Street and Adams Avenue, or I-405 to Brookhurst Street
intro: From Santa Ana, CAIR SPA is a straightforward drive southwest to Brookhurst Street in Huntington Beach.

name: Tustin
route: CA-55 south to I-405 north, exiting at Brookhurst Street
intro: From Tustin, CAIR SPA is reached by CA-55 and I-405, exiting at Brookhurst Street in Huntington Beach.

name: Seal Beach
route: Pacific Coast Highway (CA-1) south along the coast
intro: From Seal Beach, CAIR SPA is a coastal drive south on Pacific Coast Highway into Huntington Beach.

name: Anaheim
route: CA-22 west to Brookhurst Street, then south
intro: From Anaheim, CAIR SPA is reached by CA-22 and Brookhurst Street, which runs south all the way to our clinic.

name: Laguna Beach
route: Pacific Coast Highway (CA-1) north through Newport Beach
intro: From Laguna Beach, CAIR SPA is a scenic drive north on Pacific Coast Highway through Newport Beach.

name: Buena Park
route: Beach Boulevard (CA-39) south to I-405, then Brookhurst Street
intro: From Buena Park, CAIR SPA is a drive south on Beach Boulevard and I-405 to Brookhurst Street in Huntington Beach.

name: Fullerton
route: Euclid Street south, then Brookhurst Street
intro: From Fullerton, CAIR SPA is a drive south through Anaheim and Garden Grove on Euclid and Brookhurst Street.

name: Long Beach
route: I-405 south to the Brookhurst Street exit
intro: From Long Beach, CAIR SPA is a drive south on I-405 to the Brookhurst Street exit in Huntington Beach.

name: Lake Forest
intro: From Lake Forest, CAIR SPA is a drive north on I-405 to the Brookhurst Street exit in Huntington Beach.

name: Mission Viejo
route: I-5 to I-405 north, exiting at Brookhurst Street
intro: From Mission Viejo, CAIR SPA is a drive north on I-5 and I-405 to the Brookhurst Street exit in Huntington Beach.

name: Laguna Niguel
route: CA-73 or I-5 to I-405 north, exiting at Brookhurst Street
intro: From Laguna Niguel, CAIR SPA is a drive north on CA-73 or I-5 and I-405 to Brookhurst Street in Huntington Beach.

name: Yorba Linda
route: CA-91 to CA-55 south, then I-405 north to Brookhurst Street
intro: From Yorba Linda, CAIR SPA is a drive on CA-91, CA-55 and I-405 to Brookhurst Street in Huntington Beach.
